title: Incident Management & Communication
description: Communicate during outages and write post-mortems. Tests crisis communication, transparency, and root-cause analysis.

seo.overviewBody: Service outages test a company's transparency and operational resilience. Incident response leads and operations specialists create crisis communications playbooks, status page update templates (Statuspage.io), incident update cadences, and transparent post-incident reports (RCA).

deliverables.title: 1. Crisis Communications & Outage Playbook
deliverables.desc: Playbook defining incident severity tiers (Sev-1 critical outage vs Sev-3 minor bug), comms leads, and update channels.

deliverables.title: 2. Status Page Incident Update Templates
deliverables.desc: Pre-approved copy templates for Investigating, Identified, Monitoring, and Resolved status page updates.

deliverables.title: 3. Post-Incident Root Cause Communication (RCA) Memo
deliverables.desc: Customer-facing RCA memo explaining technical root causes, impact duration, and preventive infrastructure upgrades.

faqs.question: How frequently should customer status pages be updated during an active outage?
faqs.answer: Update status pages every 15 to 30 minutes during major Sev-1 outages, even if the update simply confirms that engineers are continuing active investigation.

faqs.question: What key elements belong in a customer-facing Post-Incident Report (RCA)?
faqs.answer: Executive Summary, Incident Timeline (UTC), Root Cause Explanation, Impact Summary, Immediate Remediation Steps, and Long-Term Preventive Actions.

faqs.question: How do you maintain customer trust during major service downtime?
faqs.answer: Acknowledge issues instantly, communicate transparently without hiding technical mistakes, provide frequent updates, and offer pro-rated service credits when appropriate.
